infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Costonomy Jobs uses your photos only when you choose a profile photo, a restaurant logo, or a picture of a document to add.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Costonomy Jobs checks your location once, only when you tap 'Check in' at an interview or on your joining day, to confirm you've arrived. It never tracks you in the background.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Costonomy Jobs uses the camera only when you choose to take a profile photo or a picture of a document.
